profiles.shortDescription: Datasensing S.r.l. develops, manufactures and supplies industrial sensors, machine vision products and machine safety devices. Its catalogue is organised into three product groups: Machine Vision, Sensors, and Safety and Guidance. The products are used in manufacturing automation and intralogistics.
fullDescription: The company describes Datasensing as merging Datalogic's Sensor & Safety and Machine Vision business unit with M.D. Micro Detectors, both with 50 years of experience, representing the history of sensors in Italy since the early '70s. The site states that it has its headquarters in Italy and offices in Europe, China and the US, together with a qualified network of distribution partners. Its legal notice states that Datasensing and the Datasensing logo are trademarks of Datalogic S.r.l., and the site is published under the copyright of Datasensing S.r.l. The Global Presence page lists DATALOGIC S.P.A., Via Candini 2, 40012 Lippo di Calderara di Reno (BO), Italy, under the heading Headquarters.

The published portfolio is stated to comprise more than 200 product lines, including 22500 standard and custom part numbers, protected by over 100 patents. The Machine Vision group covers smart cameras, vision processors, cameras and accessories. The Sensors group covers area, capacitive, inductive, photoelectric and ultrasonic sensors together with sensor accessories and specialities. The Safety and Guidance group covers safety light curtains, safety sensors, lidars, safety control units, safety laser scanners, encoders and accessories.

The site groups its applications by industry. Automotive covers assembling, car components and paint-shop; Electronics covers PCB assembling; Packaging covers food & beverage, pharmaceutical and other packaged goods; General Manufacturing covers ceramics/glass, metalworking, paper & printing, and textile/leather; Intralogistics covers end of line/palletizing, conveyor & sorting, AGV/AGF/AMR and warehousing. The company states that its mission is to create added value through smart sensing solutions based on sustainable standard and custom products, developed with care and leading know how.

profiles.shortDescription: Freund Maschinenfabrik GmbH & Co. KG develops and produces machines and hand tools for slaughtering and meat cutting. Its catalogue covers splitter bandsaws, circular and reciprocating saws, shears and cutters, dehiders, stunning equipment, trimmers, vacuum systems and sterilisation systems. The equipment is offered for small plants (butcheries) as well as medium throughput and industrial or large plants.
fullDescription: The company is based at Greifswalder Str. 5, 33106 Paderborn, Germany. Its About page states that Freund has been developing and producing machines and equipment for humane and economical meat production and cutting for well more than 100 years, and markets them as "German Quality Slaughter-Tools". Freund describes itself as a family business with around 140 employees worldwide, with its own subsidiaries in Spain, the United Kingdom and China and branches in Colombia and Russia. It states that more than 80 percent of its production is exported to over 100 countries worldwide and that it works with more than 75 representatives abroad.

The online product catalogue lists 148 products. They can be filtered by application (Accessories, Breastbone, Cutting, Dehiding, Feet, Feet/Neck, Horns, Horns/legs, Neck, Oesophagus, Quaertering, Rectum, Splitting, Sticking, Stiumlating, Stunning, Trim, Vacuum), by animal (cattles, pigs, sheep), by animal weight (norm, medium-sized and heavy animals), by plant capacity (small plant/butchery, medium throughput plant, industrial/large plant) and by drive (pneumatic, electric, hydraulic, manually). The printed product categories include Splitter Bandsaw, Circular-Breastbone-Saw, Circular Saws, Circular Saws for Automation, Reciprocating Saws, Shears and Cutters, Quartering Shear, Trimmer, Dehider, Rectum Cutters, Sticking Knives, Electro-Stun-Tongs, Electronic Stunning Equipment, Electronic Stimulation Equipment, Pneumatic Bolt Stunner, Vacuum Systems, Sterilization-systems, Sterilization-bowls, Steam-Vacuum-Sanitiser-Systems, Spring Balancers, Oesophagus Clip, Animal Drover, Circular Cutting Knives and Sawblades.

Individual models are published on their own pages. The BBK28-06D is a Circular-Breastbone-Saw offered for pig and sow slaughtering at medium & high throughput plants, described with a mechanical motorbrake MMB, a circular sawblade gross toothed KGZ and a knife-guard that prevents cutting into organs. Other catalogued models include the BBS14 brisket shear, the BBKM25-06D, the BBH30-03 and BBST30-13 reciprocating brisket saws, the AS28 quartering shear, the Trimmer 35 adaptive trimmer and the MOVIT-M animal drover. Alongside new equipment the site offers used machines, downloads and videos, digital operating manuals and technical service.

profiles.shortDescription: Champion Pneumatic designs and manufactures compressed air systems. Its range covers reciprocating, rotary vane, rotary scroll and rotary screw compressors in oil-lubricated and oil-less versions, together with air treatment products, condensate management equipment, compressed air piping and compressor lubricants. Products are sold and serviced through more than 750 authorized distributors and service centers nationwide.
fullDescription: Champion states that it utilizes a century of experience in designing and manufacturing air compressor systems and that, with over 100 years of experience, its compressors are the product of decades of design and development. It describes the compressed air market's widest breadth of products — reciprocating, rotary vane, rotary scroll and rotary screw — and says that choosing the right product for the application is key to continuing the success that was started in 1919. The company names automotive, industrial, woodworking and agriculture among the industries its products keep running, and reports more than 750 authorized air compressor Distributors and Service Centers Nationwide.

The compressor catalogue is split into three groups. Reciprocating compressors are published as the A-Series, Advantage, Climate Control, Commandair, Engine Driven, PL-Series, R-Series, RV-Series, VP-Series and Revolution. Oil lubricated rotary compressors are published as the D Series, DRS Series, L-Series, LRS Series and LV/LVR Series. Oil-less reciprocating and rotary scroll compressors are published as the CA-Series, CA-Series ES and V & W Series. Compressor lubricants are offered as ChampLub for reciprocating compressors and RotorLub for rotary compressors.

Air treatment is organised into refrigerated air dryers, desiccant air dryers, and filters and separators; the filters page prints the FRL Filter Regulator Lubricator, the XCME Series Mist Eliminators and the CFL Series Compressor Air Filters, states that CFF Series filters were designed so they could be mounted for left or right entry, and says Champion's filters have been tested to CAGI standards and fall under the ISO 8573.1 air quality classes. Condensate management covers electric timed drains, pneumatic and mechanical drains and oil water separators, including the CSP EnviroChamp 2 series, which the site describes as designed for 90°F at 90% RH summertime conditions and able to separate oil/discharge water to levels of 15 ppm, with heaters and distributor listed as optional. Compressed air piping is presented as total solutions for air, vacuum and inert gas systems, and covers DRI Products, Quick-Lock/Big-Lock Tubing and the CHX Series.

profiles.shortDescription: Rehlko is the power business formerly branded Kohler Power Systems; its Power Systems site carries the line "Kohler Power Systems is now Rehlko". The Power Systems catalogue covers diesel, gaseous and mobile generators, automatic transfer switches, paralleling switchgear, generator set controllers and accessories. The corporate site groups the wider company into Industrial Energy Systems, Powertrain Technologies and Home Energy.
fullDescription: The manufacturer's Power Systems site organises its North American offering into Diesel generators, Gaseous generators, ATS - Automatic transfer switches, Paralleling switchgear, Mobile generators, Controllers and Accessories. It presents these as scalable, high-efficiency systems for mission-critical environments from data centers and healthcare facilities to industrial operations and telecommunications, backed by parts, warranty and service programmes delivered by factory-trained and certified technicians with 24/7 nationwide support.

The controller directory lists the APM402, APM603 and APM804 controllers together with the Decision-Maker 3500 and the MPAC 1200 and MPAC 1500 transfer-switch controllers. The site prints their working envelopes, for example a product range up to 1000 kW for the APM402, KD Series 700 kW and above for the APM804, and an amperage range up to 4000 A at 115-600 V for the MPAC units.

The corporate site at rehlko.com groups the company's activity into Industrial Energy Systems, Powertrain Technologies and Home Energy, and describes industrial generators, uninterruptible power systems and complex microgrids for everything from data centers to hospitals; its banner reads "Kohler Energy is now Rehlko". A separate site, the Power Systems India contact page, lists plants in Wisconsin, USA; Brest, France; and Changzhou, China.

profiles.shortDescription: ELKO Elektrokovina Maribor manufactures asynchronous electric motors and water pumps. Its programme covers single-phase and three-phase squirrel-cage motors, external-rotor motors, clean water pumps, dirty water pumps and sewage pumps, hydropower stations and hydroblocks, and submersible propeller mixers. As services to third parties the plant also casts and machines components in aluminium, copper, brass, steel and grey cast iron.
fullDescription: The site describes the company as a manufacturer of asynchronous electric motors and pumps for water, operating as TSN d.o.o., PE ELKO Elektrokovina at Tržaška cesta 23 in Maribor. It states a fifty-year tradition in the development and manufacture of these products and roughly 35,000 m² of production facilities combining foundry work with mechanical processing.

The motor programme is presented as single-phase asynchronous motors with a short-circuit cage of closed design up to 2.2 kW, three-phase asynchronous motors of the same design up to 11 kW, and single-phase and three-phase motors with an external rotor. The company's own IEC motor catalogue prints the 2EK, 3EK, ESK, EKSK and TZF type designations, including TZF 103 and TZF 136 external-rotor sizes.

Alongside motors, the product menu lists clean water pumps, dirty water pumps and sewage pumps, hydropower stations and hydroblocks, and submersible propeller mixers. Under Services the company offers mechanical treatment to third parties - CNC and classical milling and turning, grinding, sawing and cutting - and foundry services, casting by pressure die, mould and sand-mould methods; the mechanical treatment page states that castings in aluminium, copper, brass, steel and grey cast iron are cast and processed on CNC equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Stone is the hydraulic power-unit brand of Hydraulic Technologies. It supplies power units and component kits built from motors, pumps, reservoirs, valves and plumbing. Its modular Pick-A-Pack range lets users configure a unit from catalogued component options.
fullDescription: The brand page presents Stone as a pillar brand of Hydraulic Technologies, with a legacy of proven performance in motors, pumps, reservoirs, valves and plumbing for industrial solutions. It describes the Stone Pick-A-Pack product range as the pinnacle of modular construction in hydraulics, assembled from AC or DC motor options, different pumps and reservoirs, and the accompanying valves and plumbing.

The Stone catalogue published on the manufacturer's site sets out the component kit families by prefix: KMC motor kits for continuous-duty single-phase and three-phase AC motors and KMD kits for 4.5" field-wound DC motors, with the C-face mountings carried by separate motor adaptors - KM96 for 182/184 NEMA C face, KM97 for 56/143/145 NEMA C face and KM98-80, KM98-90 and KM98-100 for IEC 80, 90 and 100 frame C face. Alongside these it lists KP and KPJ pump kits of the AFC series, KR reservoir and tank kits in steel and plastic, KN endheads with metric or UNC footmounts and SAE, BSPP or NPT ports, KC integral valves, KFC flow-control kits and KU unload assemblies, plus complete AC-10 and DC series power units such as AC-10AH, AC-10KS, AC-10TC, AC-10FP, DC-10SF and the DC-30APU auxiliary power unit.

The site names agriculture, mobile equipment, industrial equipment and automotive repair equipment as the areas Stone serves, and the catalogue's application index adds specific machine types built around these units, including auto hoists, tire changers, dump trailers and trucks, tail gates, man lifts, scissor lifts, dock levelers, snow plows, truck-mounted cranes and material handling equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: AO ENA manufactures industrial centrifugal pumps and electric pump units. Its catalogue is organised by application and covers pumps for oil refining, chemical processing, shipbuilding, fuel and nuclear power, transfer of light petroleum products, and water and heat supply for municipal services. The plant is located in Shchelkovo, Moscow Region, Russia.
fullDescription: AO ENA has been producing industrial centrifugal pumps since 1950 and is located at ul. Zavodskaya 14 in Shchelkovo, Moscow Region. The company designs and manufactures centrifugal pumps and electric pump units and states that it is a full member of the Russian Association of Pump Manufacturers (RAPN).

For oil refining the company publishes the NKA oil console pump units, the NDM and NDMO multisection two-bearing pumps, the NDR two-bearing radial pumps and the KhP-E semi-submersible electric pump units. ENA states that the NDM range fully conforms to API 610 type BB5, and that this equipment is intended for aggressive, flammable and toxic liquids handled at elevated temperatures and working pressures in hydrocarbon processing and transport, with requirements covering shaft rigidity, vibration levels and replaceable wear ring arrangements.

Other published lines cover the chemical industry, with the AKh and Kh horizontal console units, KhM monobloc pumps, semi-submersible units, KhG-E sealed magnetic-drive pumps and ANM-E pumps for ammonia; shipbuilding, with the NTsV, NTsVS, EPN, EKN and ETsN families; transfer of light petroleum products with the SVN, STsL and STsN families; and water and heat supply and municipal services with the KM, K, KML, SM and NV families. The company also offers metalworking services to external customers.
productFamilies: Насосы для топливной и ядерной энергетики
Насосы для водо-теплоснабжения и коммунального хозяйства

profiles.shortDescription: Gamet Bearings is a range of super precision tapered roller bearings presented by HB Bearings Ltd on its own site, which states the bearings have been manufactured since 1956 in the UK. The published range covers single row bearings with a plain cup, a flanged cup (C Type) and a constant preload arrangement (P Type), and double row bearings as G Type and as a flanged-cup H Type. The site names the machine tool industry and other sectors with high precision bearing requirements as the applications.
fullDescription: The Gamet product overview page states that Gamet Bearings, high precision tapered roller bearings, have been manufactured since 1956 in the UK, and that the business was originally founded to serve the machine tool industry. The Gamet pages are published on hb-bearings.com and carry the copyright line of HB Bearings Ltd; the site's statutory information page gives the registered name HB BEARINGS LIMITED, company number 1071242, at Riverside Works, Honley, Holmfirth, Huddersfield HD9 6PQ, United Kingdom. The manufacturing page records QMS ISO 9001:2015 certification.

The published product range is divided into Single Row Bearings, offered with a Plain Cup, a Flanged Cup designated C Type and a Constant Preload Bearing designated P Type, and Double Row Bearings, offered as Double Row G Type and as Double Row, Flanged Cup H Type. The site notes that the G and H types can be pre-adjusted with spacers to give GE and HE double row bearings at a required assembly end play or preload. Gamet Blue 1, Gamet Blue 2 and Gamet Blue 3 appear as featured items on the same page. The site states Cone Bore Run-out tolerances ranging from 0.5 microns to 1.5 microns.

Besides the machine tool industry, the overview page names the coating of materials, photographic emulsions or adhesives, and the printing and packaging industries among the sectors with high precision bearing requirements, and Motorsport appears in the site navigation. HB Bearings also states that it specialises in the manufacture of special metric and imperial bearings and standard bearings which are difficult to obtain and hard to source, listing precision radial, deep groove ball, cylindrical roller, angular contact and duplex types as well as thin section, spherical plain and hybrid ceramic bearings, with a maximum capacity of 1 metre outside diameter.

profiles.headquarters: Lippo di Calderara di Reno, Italy
profiles.shortDescription: GSM is a gearbox brand acquired by STM S.p.A., the Italian mechanical power transmission manufacturer, whose about page records under the year 2000 that STM Team acquires G.S.M. SpA. The manufacturer-owned catalogue covers Inline Gearboxes, Parallel Gearboxes, Shaft Mounted Gearboxes, Bevel Helical Gearboxes and Planetary Gearboxes, together with Worm Gearboxes, Helical Worm Gearboxes, Right Angle Gearboxes, Mechanical Speed Variators, Electric Motors, Electronic Speed Variators and Inverters. STM supplies these drives to light and heavy mechanics.
fullDescription: STM S.p.A. presents itself on its own site as a supplier of solutions for controlling and powering transmission in industry, founded in 1976 and based at Via del Maccabreccia, 39 - 40012 Lippo di Calderara di Reno (BO), Italy. The about page timeline records that S.T.M. achieved ISO 9001 Certification in 1998, that GSM obtained its ISO 9001 Certification in 1999, that STM Team acquires G.S.M. SpA in 2000, that in 2019 a new production centre was established together with the affiliated firms Rettifiche RESCA, VP Tornitura and Met, and that STM Team acquires the company Neri Motori Srl in 2022.

The product directory is organised into High Tech, Standard, Electronic and Custom lines. Within High Tech the site prints the motion series AR/1, A, CAM, PT, P, PE, PL, O and SM; the industrial series RXP 700, RXP 800, RXO/700, RXO/800, RXP/EST, RXO-V-EST 700-800, RXP/E, RXO/TR, RXO-O 800, RX/MX, RXMaster, QL and RXP 800 /CR, together with gearboxes carrying the GSMoveRX base plate and the GSMineRX swing base; and the heavy-duty planetary series EX, EX/V, EXB and EXR. The Standard and Electronic lines add Worm Gearboxes, Helical Worm Gearboxes, Right Angle Gearboxes, Mechanical Speed Variators, Electric Motors, Electronic Speed Variators and Inverters.
STM's applications section names the sectors it addresses: Chemical, Conveyor, Lifting, Recycling, Energy, Mining Technologies, Steel, Fluid and Sugar.

profiles.shortDescription: JISKOOT is the hydrocarbon sampling brand of Sensia, which describes it as having a history of designing and manufacturing sampling products to meet the rigorous demands of the global oil and gas market. The documented range covers gas samplers, liquid cell and liquid probe samplers, loop extractors, sample receivers, sampling control systems and laboratory equipment. The products are used for custody transfer and fiscal sampling of natural gas, bitumen, crude oils, condensates and refined fuel.
fullDescription: Sensia's manufacturer-owned product directory groups the JISKOOT range under custody transfer and fiscal sampling. The listed families are JISKOOT Gas Samplers, JISKOOT Liquid Cell Samplers, JISKOOT Liquid Probe Samplers, JISKOOT Loop Extractors, JISKOOT Sample Receivers, JISKOOT Sampling Control Systems and JISKOOT Laboratory Equipment.

The site states that the sampling products serve production, midstream and downstream markets, handling natural gas, bitumen, crude oils, condensates and refined fuel, and that they help operators manage the financial and contractual risk that is associated with hydrocarbon custody transfer applications. JISKOOT appears on Sensia's measurement pages alongside the SWINTON TECHNOLOGY, BARTON, NUFLO, CALDON, CLIF MOCK and QRATE brands, within a measurement portfolio whose integrated systems are listed as custody transfer and metering, crude oil and condensate sampling, well pad control and distributed measurement, LNG sampling and metering, and HIPPS.

Sensia describes itself as a joint venture between Rockwell Automation and SLB that since 2019 has combined deep domain expertise with industrial-scale automation and digital innovation, positioned as solving challenges from the reservoir to refinery. Its contact page gives the address Sensia LLC, Energy Tower IV, 15th floor, 11750 Katy Freeway, Houston, TX 77079. The company further states that on April 1, 2026 the Sensia joint venture will undergo an orderly dissolution, with its business units transitioning to Rockwell Automation and SLB; Measurement Products and Solutions is listed among the units moving to SLB.

profiles.shortDescription: Lamson is a brand of multistage centrifugal blowers and exhausters offered under the Hoffman & Lamson name, which the site states is among the compressed air and gas technologies manufactured by Gardner Denver Inc. as part of the Nash Division. The wider Hoffman & Lamson catalogue covers multistage centrifugal, positive displacement, high-speed turbo, regenerative, fabricated and remanufactured blowers, legacy central vacuum support, controls and energy management, and custom engineered solutions. The equipment is supplied to water and wastewater treatment plants and to general industrial air and gas applications.
fullDescription: The Hoffman & Lamson site states that the Hoffman and Lamson brands of centrifugal blowers and exhausters are among the many compressed air and gas technologies manufactured by Gardner Denver Inc., that they are part of the Nash Division, and that Lamson was established in 1880 and Hoffman in 1905. The about page records that the two brands joined the Gardner Denver Inc. family in 2001 and 1996 respectively, as part of the Gardner Denver Nash Division, and have since combined their lines of centrifugal blowers and industrial central vacuum solutions.

Lamson multistage centrifugal blowers and exhausters are catalogued by inlet group. The Small Inlet page lists the Lamson 260, 310, 400, 510 and 550; the Medium Flow Inlet page lists the Lamson 510, 550, 850, 870 and 1260; and the High Flow Inlet page lists the Lamson 1270, 1400, 1600, 1870, 2000 and 2400, alongside Hoffman frames in each group. The wider catalogue adds lobe and screw positive displacement blower packages, high-speed turbo blowers, the fabricated T Series, the regenerative TurboPak and TurboTron lines, remanufactured blowers, legacy industrial central vacuum accessories and parts, and controls including Rigel Controls, MultiGard II, MDOCS, analog monitors and digital control panels.

The site names water and wastewater treatment applications including aerated grit chambers, aeration in wastewater treatment, filter backwash, gas boosting in anaerobic digestion, membrane bioreactors, sequencing batch reactors and sewage sludge incineration. Its general industrial applications are given as air knives, carbon black, coal bed methane recovery, ethanol production, fiberglass manufacturing, forced air oxidation in wet flue gas desulfurization, froth flotation and landfill gas extraction. The about page states that ISO quality certified LEAN manufacturing and testing facilities in Bentleyville, Pennsylvania USA and Boshan, China produce engineered to order packages, with 22 high-performance models covering flow ranges from 90 to 41,000 CFM.

profiles.shortDescription: LMF – Leobersdorfer Maschinenfabrik GmbH manufactures high-pressure compressors and complete compressor packages for air and technical gases. The company builds reciprocating machines and also supplies rotary screw compressors. Its equipment is used by industrial, energy, oil & gas and petrochemical operators.
fullDescription: LMF's own site describes the company as a compressor manufacturer based in Leobersdorf, south of Vienna, established in 1850 and operating with what it calls a tradition spanning over 175 years. The site states that LMF became a member of the Kaishan Group in 2016 and that it exports more than 95% of its production.

The industrial applications section documents air and technical-gas machines with a power range from 5 to 125 kW and delivery pressure from 30 to 450 bar, referencing installed units such as V17 5518 L8, V17 4518 L8, V19 5621 L40, V16 4411 L6.9 and VC-3236 N4.2. Listed uses include circuit-breaker and brake air, descaling and pressure testing, bottle filling, breathing air and starting air.

For oil, gas and process duties the site describes fully integrated compressor packages. It states a frame rating from 100 up to 6,000 kW and, as a separate point, a modular design of up to six cylinders per frame, with pressures up to 1,000 bar. Documented duties cover acid gas injection, gas gathering, LNG and BOG handling, pipeline transmission, refinery and hydrogen services, and the page shows machines designated B92-209 N16.8, B121-117 N3.8 and B 222 - 274 N 1.6. Further documented application areas are alternative energy, PET, pipeline evacuation and seismic research, and the download area lists brochures for V-Type air-cooled and water-cooled machines, PET-VC, CNG-CBG, API 618, mobile solutions, seismic research and bare blocks.

profiles.shortDescription: Autel S.r.l. a socio unico designs, manufactures and services electrical and electronic systems for industrial automation, plant control and industrial air filtration. Its output is organised into three business units: mechanical filtration valves and tanks, multi-sector electronic controllers and displays, and control panels. The company supplies industrial operators in sectors including food, agriculture, energy, generator sets and waste treatment.
fullDescription: Autel's company page states that the firm was founded in 1980 and works from Via D. Bagnoli 9 in Sassuolo, in the province of Modena. It describes itself as offering complete and customised solutions across mechanical filtration, electronics and switchgear, states that since 2009 Autel has also integrated the mechanical component, and lists ISO 9001 certification obtained in 2001 alongside ASME (2011), ATEX (2013) and UL (2014) certifications.

The mechanical filtration line covers cleaning systems for industrial air filtration plants. The filtration division pages present valves in sizes from ¾" up to 3" ½ and tanks divided into tanks with integrated valves, tanks for 90° valves, air cannons, tanks for cartridge filters and standard tank accessories, with the DOMINO - DM70 listed in pilot-group and pneumatic-valve variants. The electronics line is a multi-sector catalogue of filtration controllers and controllers for other application sectors, listing items such as ECOMATIC NET, the ECOSERIAL and RPB two-wire and advanced serial systems, DPF differential-pressure devices, STA43/57/70 and DR-35 displays, MNT8IO and MNT16IO auxiliary modules, and the ATS-25, ATS-45, ATS-25E, ATS-45E, ATS-I, SA-05, SA-12C, GE-A01, RTE-24-12-20A and D100-E units.

The third unit builds control panels, described on the site as motor starter and control cabinets, PLC-based automation, smart factory and certified global solutions. The sectors page names food, generator sets, pharmaceutical, agriculture, industrial filtration, energy, nautical, industrial automation and waste treatment as application areas, and the company lists offices and partners in China, Canada, the USA, Mexico, Chile, Austria, Germany, Poland, Portugal, Spain, South Africa and Turkey.

profiles.shortDescription: STM Products S.r.l. develops and manufactures custom industrial electronics. Its documented ranges are electronic control systems for bakery and food equipment, water chillers and doser-mixers for bakery and food water preparation, and deterrent systems for fishing technology. The company states that design, development, production and testing are all handled internally.
fullDescription: STM PRODUCTS describes itself on its own site as a full-cycle company founded in 1983 from the vision of Alessandro, Antonio and Luca, three professionals, with the name STM containing the initials of the founders. The history page states that for over forty years the company has been a name in custom electronic solutions and that design, development, production and testing have always been managed internally, and the site header carries the line "+40 years of development and production of industrial electronics". The legal entity and address printed in the site footer are STM Products S.r.l., Via Morgagni, 14 (entrance at Via Schiaparelli, 15), I-37135 Verona. The company states that it applies its electronic know-how to different sectors, naming baking, industrial ovens, marine technologies, automotive, railway and banking, and that its connectivity and internally developed software are open, flexible and customizable rather than subject to proprietary constraints.

The electronic solutions area is split into Control for Food and Control for No Food. Under Control for Food the site lists the SENSATIC CELLS, SENSATIC OVENS and SENSATIC MIXER lines. SENSATIC OVENS is described as designed for rotary, deck, electric and convection ovens, with touch screen control and STM-Cloud connection, and comprises the ROC-TP3, ROC-6D and ROC-E controllers for rotary ovens, the DEOC, DEOC-TP3 and DEOC-G controllers for electric deck ovens, and VEGOC for convection ovens.

A separate Water for Bakery & Food division covers professional and industrial water chillers and automatic, thermostatic and manual doser-mixers. The site also documents a Fishing Technology division with passive deterrents in the Yellow Line and Orange Line and interactive deterrents in the Green Line.

profiles.shortDescription: Carver Pump Company designs and manufactures centrifugal pumps at its plant in Muscatine, Iowa. Its published product lines cover end-suction, multistage ring-section, vertical sump and cantilevered, in-line vertical and lube-oil pumps, together with packaged domestic water booster systems. The pumps are built to industrial, municipal, marine and naval specifications.
fullDescription: The company page states that Carver Pump was founded by Roy Carver Sr. in 1938, that the original factory was located next to the Mississippi river in Muscatine, Iowa, and that the company is headquartered in Muscatine, Iowa, where its pumps are engineered and manufactured. The same page describes Carver as building pumps to the most demanding engineering specifications and military standards in the world, says that for decades its products have lived up to the intense demands of the US Navy, and states that its quality management system is certified by Intertek to conform to ISO 9001:2015.

The product line published on carverpump.com comprises API Maxum OH2 (API 610 Compliant End-Suction Pump), Maxum OH1 (Heavy-Duty, Horizontal End-Suction Pump), RS (Multistage, Ring Section Pump), GH (End-Suction Centrifugal Pump), G2C (Vertical, Cantilevered Pump), G2S (Vertical Sump Pump for Depths to 22 Feet), M Series (ASTM F998 Close-Coupled Centrifugal Pump), 850 (Horizontal Filtrate Pump), 855 (handles up to 26" Hg vacuum), KWP (Non-Clogging Process Pump), VLO (Vertical Lube Oil Pump), RSV (In-line Vertical Multistage Pump) and DPC Systems (Domestic Water Booster Systems). The Resources page additionally publishes brochures and manuals for further Carver models, among them the API Maxum OH3, GHJM and KEF.

The M Series page describes an end-suction pump for handling freshwater, seawater and light hydrocarbons in commercial marine and naval applications. Conforming to the requirements of ASTM F998 including the Navy supplement, hydraulic performance extends to 5,000 GPM and 713 feet of head, a range covered by 24 sizes in 316 SS and CD4MCuN duplex SS as standard materials, with power to 300 HP. The page states that the pump is designed to meet naval requirements including MIL-S-901 Shock, MIL-STD-167-1 Type I Environmental Vibration, MIL-STD-740-1 Airborne Noise and MIL-STD-740-2 Structureborne Noise, with a mechanical seal in accordance with ASTM F1511. The applications section names commercial, desalination / municipal, industrial, marine, minerals & mining, oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation and pulp & paper duties.

profiles.shortDescription: WOLF GmbH manufactures heating and air handling equipment in Mainburg, Germany. Its professional range covers modular and custom air handling units, (semi) central and decentralised ventilation units, pool units, fan wall systems, air heating and fan systems, heat pumps and controls. The company states that it is a subsidiary of Ariston Holding.
fullDescription: WOLF states that Anton Wolf founded WOLF in Mainburg in 1963, initially producing parts for hop processing machines and heat generators. Ventilation and air handling units were introduced during the early seventies and the company entered the heating technology sector a decade later. Today WOLF is a subsidiary of Ariston Holding; its imprint gives the address as Industriestraße 1, DE-84048 Mainburg and states that WOLF is owned by Ariston Holding N.V. WOLF Power Systems is described as the company's representative in the combined heat and power sector.

The air handling range is published as KG Top modular appliances in 23 sizes, KG Flex custom appliances for air flow rates of up to 350,000 m³/h, (semi) central and decentralised units including CSL-800, CRL, CRL evo, CRL evo max, CKL evo, CFL-WRG, CFL-EC, CGL 2 edu and CFL edu, pool units comprising KG Flex Pool and CKL Pool, and the Fanwall DCA modular fan wall. Air heating and fan systems listed include the LH, LH-EC, LH-ATEX, LHD, LH-Mobil, TLHK, TLHD, TL-2, LD-15, DV-2 and ER units.

The CKL Pool page describes compact air handling units for ventilation, dehumidification and heating of private, hotel and therapy pools, available in three sizes with nominal flow rates of 1300, 2000 and 3000 m³/h covering air volumes from 800 to 3000 m³/h. Three options for heat supply are offered, and from 1300 m³/h an integrated high-efficiency heat pump on R513A refrigerant is fitted. The units use an epoxy resin-coated aluminium plate heat exchanger for heat recovery, infinitely variable EC fans and a factory-tested external control cabinet compatible with WOLF Smartset, Link Pro and GLT systems via Modbus, BACnet/IP, LON or a web module. WOLF states that the units are designed in accordance with the applicable hygiene guidelines VDI 6022 and VDI 3803 and tested by TÜV Süd according to DIN EN 1886.

WOLF publishes design and selection tools for professionals, including the AHU Configurator, Airheater Configurator, BIM Browser and Smartset/Link Pro, alongside Downloads Heating and Downloads Airhandling document libraries. The company page states that WOLF has 60 sales partners in more than 50 countries and that WOLF products and system solutions are used in buildings ranging from single-family and multi-family homes to schools, universities and administrative buildings, as well as factories, airports, railway stations, hotels, hospitals, swimming facilities and leisure venues.

profiles.shortDescription: AEG Low Voltage is a low-voltage installation-device programme published under the AEG trademark, which the site states is a registered trademark used under licence from AB Electrolux (publ). The published range consists of AEG installation devices such as miniature circuit breakers, residual current circuit breakers and surge protection devices, presented as providing reliable electrical protection in new construction and renovation.
fullDescription: The site presents itself as a brand programme rather than an independent manufacturer. Its footer carries the notice '© Copyright 2024 ABB' together with the statement that AEG is a registered trademark used under license from AB Electrolux (publ), and the provider information page states that the website is provided by ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd, registered in Zurich, Switzerland. The footer and contact page give the central sales service for AEG installation products as Busch-Jaeger Elektro GmbH, Freisenbergstraße, 58513 Lüdenscheid.

The homepage is headed 'AEG Line — your partner in the field of low voltage' and states: 'Whether new construction or renovation. The AEG installation devices such as miniature circuit breakers, residual current circuit breakers, surge protection devices provide reliable electrical protection.'

The guidelines page publishes master data for the AEG Line — BMEcat ETIM data and master data as an Excel file including product images, updated once a quarter — together with safety instructions, among them the symbol notice 'Installation by qualified electricians only'. The contact page states that the AEG Low Voltage online catalog offers search by article number, order number or full text for operating instructions, dimensional and connection diagrams, tender text, certificates, software and parts lists.

profiles.shortDescription: IBS Industrie-Brenner-Systeme GmbH develops and produces industrial burners and burner systems for industrial furnaces and thermal processing plants. Alongside burners it supplies combustion components such as ball valves, gas filters, air gas controllers, gas solenoid and control valves, servomotors, ignition transformers and combustion air fans, as well as gas governor systems, switch cabinets and hot gas generators.
fullDescription: The company describes itself as focused, since its foundation in the year 1969, on the engineering and production of energy saving and low emission industrial burners. Its history entry for 1969 reads: 'Foundation of IBS as a service company for industrial burners, development of IBS own burners for drying and incineration plants.' The company's name changed to IBS GmbH in 1990, and in 2005 IBS GmbH was purchased by today's owners and managing directors, with an intensification of research and development and an extension of the application fields of the IBS burner systems. The company address is given as IBS Industrie-Brenner-Systeme GmbH, Delsterner Straße 100 a, D-58091 Hagen, Germany.

The burner programme published on the site comprises the Process Burner CONEFIRE, Duct Burner GRIDFIRE, Recuperative Burner LOOPFIRE, Recuperative Burner RECUFIRE, Ceramic Radiant Tubes, Gas Burner GBC/GBS, Regenerative Burner REGFIRE, High Temperature Burner GBS H, Lance Burner LANCEFIRE and Pilot Burner IPB. For the GBC/GBS gas burners the site states a power range of 15 – 5000 kW, a wide control range, direct electric ignition and flame detection with ionisation rod with UV-probe possible; the GBS (Gas Burner Steel) has a flame tube made of chrome-nickel steel up to 1100 °C and the GBC (Gas Burner Ceramic) a silicon carbide flame tube up to 1350 °C.

Applications named for these burners include melting, heating and heat treatment furnaces in the iron and steel industry and melting furnaces, heating plants and heat treatment plants for non-ferrous heavy metal and light metal, kilns, batch kilns and tunnel furnaces in brickworks and the ceramic industry, and further thermal processes such as post-combustion plants, hot gas generators and drying plants in paper production and the food industry, as well as utilization as ignition and back-up burner.

profiles.shortDescription: cab Produkttechnik GmbH & Co KG manufactures label printing and product marking systems. Its range covers label printers, print and apply systems, labeling heads and dispensers, marking lasers, label software and consumables, together with an electronics division supplying PCB separators, PCB magazines, PCB connectors, IC sockets and contacts. The devices are used to mark individual components, units, products and packaging in production and logistics.
fullDescription: The company states its full name as cab Produkttechnik GmbH & Co KG, located at Wilhelm-Schickard-Str. 14 in 76131 Karlsruhe, Germany, and gives 1975 as its founding year. It describes itself as an owner-operated family company, reports being located in eight countries with more than 500 distribution partners, and states 105 million Euros group turnover in fiscal year 2025. Mechanical and plastic components used in the devices are manufactured at the Sömmerda site near Erfurt.

The marking portfolio published on the site is grouped into label printers (MACH1/MACH2, EOS2/EOS5, MACH 4S, SQUIX including SQUIX Linerless, SQUIX 4 M, SQUIX 4 MT and SQUIX UHF RFID, plus XC Q and XD Q), print and apply systems (HERMES Q, HERMES QL, Hermes C with their applicators, SQUIX applicators, AXON 1 and AXON 2, ROXI with HERMES applicators, IXOR +, IXOR, PX Q and PX QS), labeling heads and label dispensers (ROXI, ROXI with HERMES applicators, IXOR +, IXOR, and HS and VS), marking lasers (XENO 1, XENO 3, XENO 4 and their plus variants, LM+, FL+, LSG+100E and cabLase), the cablabel S3 label software with Database Connector and Network Manager, and labels and ribbons.

A separate electronics division covers PCB handling and interconnection components: HEKTOR 2 and MAESTRO PCB separators (MAESTRO 2, 2M, MAESTRO 3E, MAESTRO 4S, MAESTRO 4X and MAESTRO 5L), PCB magazines of Series 100, 180, 300 and Series 6000, 7000, pin and socket connectors, female and male jumpers, DIL, PGA, BGA, PLCC and QFP sockets and adapters, and socket, pin and spring-loaded contacts. The about page names automotive, logistics, electrical devices, the pharmaceutical industry, chemistry, food and textiles as the sectors in which its labeling is applied.

profiles.shortDescription: Behringer GmbH is a German machinery manufacturer and iron foundry that builds sawing systems and machining lines for metal. Its range covers band saws, circular saws under the Eisele brand, and profile and plate processing lines under the Vernet brand. The company states that its customer base covers the entire metal and steel construction industry as well as mechanical and plant engineering.
fullDescription: Behringer states that its origins go back to Kirchardt, where August Behringer laid the foundation of today's company in 1919, and that the group remains entirely family-owned after more than 100 years. The company address is Industriestraße 23, 74912 Kirchardt, Germany. It describes itself as one of the few complete providers on the market, offering everything from a single source, and operates its own iron foundry producing grey cast iron and spheroidal graphite cast iron.

The sawing programme is split between BEHRINGER Bandsaws — horizontal, aluminium, horizontal mitre, vertical, large, 3D and swing frame designs — and EISELE Circular Saws, which include cold saws, mitre, high-speed and aluminium circular saws. The site also lists BEHRINGER Cast Iron Products as a product family. The Behringer Group is given as Behringer GmbH (Kirchardt, Germany), Behringer Eisele GmbH (Weilheim an der Teck, Germany), Vernet Behringer (Dijon, France), Behringer Saws Inc. (Morgantown, USA), Behringer France, Behringer Ltd. (United Kingdom) and Behringer Machinery (China).

Profile and plate machining is offered as VERNET Profile Lines and VERNET Plate Machines. The profile lines page describes CNC lines combining machining steps such as marking, drilling, milling, punching and sawing on steel products including H-beams, U-profiles, angles, flat steels and rectangular hollow profiles, and lists the HDX, HDV, MAPS, HDL and VPX ranges, the latter with the VPX94, VPX166, VPX256S, VPX250-XD and VPX350-XD angle lines. Plate machining uses the MAG multifunctional plate machines, which combine drilling, milling, marking, deburring and plasma cutting, and the FG marking-drilling-milling machines for gusset and connecting plates.

profiles.shortDescription: Diemme Filtration designs and manufactures equipment for solid-liquid separation in industrial processes. Its range comprises filter presses for dewatering, thickeners and the piston and piston-membrane pumps that feed them. The company lists applications in mining and metals, chemical and pharmaceutical, power, oil and gas, food and beverage and wastewater treatment.
fullDescription: Diemme Filtration gives its address as Via Gessi 16, 48022 Lugo, RA, Italy, and the site footer names the company Diemme Filtration srl. The site states that the Diemme Filtration brand was born in the early '70s, when the filter press left the traditional application field of the food industry. A post published on the company's own blog on 22 June 2026 reports that Oaktree-backed Aqseptence Group agreed the sale of Diemme Filtration to Sandvik Group, with Sandvik building a dedicated Filtration division around the business.

The manufacturer-owned product directory covers filter presses in the GHT-F, GHT5000F DOMINO, GHT-P, GHS, ME, AUTOMAT and KE lines, thickeners, and pumps. The pumps page states that the piston and piston-membrane pumps are designed and sized to ensure efficient and safe operation in small and medium-sized filter presses with recessed plates. The pump datasheet published on the site prints the DM/2D-FC, DM/1D, DM/1D/S, DM/1S and DM/046-70 piston pumps and the DM/PM piston-membrane pumps, whose table models are DMPM-10, DMPM-15, DMPM-20 and DMPM-30; the piston-membrane range is indicated for abrasive or corrosive liquids and filter press feed.

The company lists application sectors including chemical and pharmaceutical, dredging and soil remediation, food and beverage, mining and metals, oil and gas, power industry, quarrying and recycling, red mud, second-generation bioethanol and wastewater treatment. It also documents laboratory, engineering and R&D services around this equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: CMS S.p.A. produces numerically controlled multi-axis machining centres, thermoforming machines and waterjet cutting systems. Its machines process composite materials, carbon fibre, aluminium and light alloys, plastic, glass, stone and metals. The company has been part of the SCM Group since 2002.
fullDescription: CMS states that it was established in 1969 by Mr. Pietro Aceti, that CMS is the acronym of Costruzioni Macchine Speciali, and describes itself as a worldwide leading company specialised in the production of numerically controlled multi-axis machining centers, thermoforming machines and waterjet cutting systems. Its offices and production are at via A. Locatelli 123, 24019 Zogno (BG), Italy, and the company page states that CMS has been part of the SCM Group since 2002. The site organises its offer by material sector: Advanced materials, Plastic, Stone, Glass and Metal.

The CMS Advanced Materials products index lists 5-axis CNC machining centers for milling and drilling, a CNC machining center for the eyewear industry, CNC machining centers for gunstocks processing, wind blade working systems, Solutions for Additive Manufacturing, complete waterjet systems, solutions for automation and beam saws. Under Solutions for Additive Manufacturing the site presents the products kreator ares, kreator a3 and krearob, developed since 2018 as Large Format Additive Manufacturing solutions combining additive, subtractive and robotic processes.

Complete waterjet systems are divided into pressure intensifiers and waterjet cutting machines. The pressure intensifiers directory lists two products, tecnocut e-pump and tecnocut jetpower evo, built on intensifiers with several independent, parallel and electronically synchronised pressure multipliers; tecnocut jetpower evo is offered as a 40 HP version with 2 multipliers and a 60 HP version with 3, both reaching 4150 bar / 60,000 psi. Industries named on the CMS home page include aerospace, automotive and F1, the marine industry, production of wind turbines, engineering, eyewear, building, architecture, interior design and sculpture.
